# corpus-clean-small-change - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the operator reading projection counts.
**Outcome:** an existing helper gains one counter without changing its contract.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；1 个实施 todo + F1；仅修改既有投影模块。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 操作员看到与状态文件一致的任务计数。 | 计数来自同一投影结果。 |
| GAP-1 | 投影输出没有任务计数。 | 1 关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 给既有投影模块补一个计数
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-low — small change
  What to do / Must NOT do: 修改 `lib/projection.js:1-3` 中的投影返回值，新增 `taskCount` 字段；不改变既有字段。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: F1
  References: `lib/projection.js:1-3`；`test/*.test.mjs`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/projection.test.mjs` 退出 0，且既有投影字段逐字节不变。
  QA scenarios: Happy “count-matches-rows” 计数等于状态文件中的行数。Failure “count-drifts” 行数变化时计数同步变化。
  Commit: Y | fix(projection): report taskCount

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: —
  References: `lib/projection.js:1-3`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。

## Success criteria
| IS | Delivering todo(s) | Proving QA scenario | Evidence |
